description: Issues a csk_ key and files a first claim with it in one call: https://<subject>/ answers 200 with valid TLS, checked now; it counts if both pass. subject: a bare hostname the caller operates. Writes a key and one unlisted claim (no new key with api_key).

api_key.description: ks-1: a csk_ key you already hold; start files the first claim with it

subject.description: bare hostname you operate, e.g. docs.example.org

name: start
